---
name: Knowledge correction
about: Suggest a sourced correction to documentation or shared knowledge.
title: "[Knowledge correction] "
labels: ""
assignees: ""
---

## Resource to correct

Link the page, article, record, or repository and identify the relevant section or revision.

## Current problem

Explain what is inaccurate, outdated, missing, or unclear.

## Proposed correction

Describe the suggested wording or change.

## Sources and attribution

Provide supporting evidence and source links. Note uncertainty, attribution, and any reuse restrictions. Do not copy restricted or private material into this issue.

## Review and publication

Identify the owning project and any review needed before the correction can be accepted or published elsewhere.
